name: Vulcan Elements
activity: Building a commercial-scale plant to make rare-earth (NdFeB) permanent magnets in the US.
notes: Amount from an SEC Form D filed 2026-04-02 by Vulcan Elements Holdings Corp. (about US$430.7M sold of a US$545M offering), seen through a Form D index; no company announcement found. Axios Pro (2026-03-17, anonymous sources) reported a raise of about US$550M at a US$2B valuation. The Nov 2025 US$1.4B package was mostly a US$620M Department of War loan plus US$50M CHIPS incentives, not equity. Earlier: US$65M Series A (Aug 2025, led by Altimeter).

name: Redwood Materials
activity: Recycles lithium-ion batteries into battery materials and builds energy storage from second-life batteries (Nevada).
lead_investors: Eclipse (first close); Google joined the final close; Capricorn and Goldman Sachs Alternatives
notes: Cumulative Series E: US$350M first close (2025-10-23) plus US$75M final close (date from TechCrunch/Bloomberg). Valuation reported above US$6B (press, not company).

name: Mariana Minerals
activity: Software-led company that develops, owns and operates its own mines and refineries (Copper One in Utah, Lithium One in Texas).
lead_investors: Khosla Ventures; also Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Greenoaks, BHP Ventures and others
notes: Valuation reported about US$1.5B; a reported US$400M total includes capital going directly into project companies.

name: Noveon Magnetics
activity: Makes sintered NdFeB rare-earth magnets in Texas with a process that supports magnet recycling.
lead_investors: One Investment Management (US$200M)
notes: Part of the round was a secondary sale by existing shareholders, so not all is new money to the company.

name: General Flash
activity: Turns metal oxides directly into high-purity metal by solid-state flash electrolysis; scaling from a pilot line in Massachusetts to a commercial plant.
lead_investors: Lux Capital and Overmatch Ventures
notes: Combined seed and Series A equity. Target plant about 1,000 t/yr by 2027. Metals produced not specified.

name: Mangrove Lithium
activity: Electrochemical refining of lithium from brine, hard rock, clay or recycled batteries into battery-grade chemicals (Delta, British Columbia).
lead_investors: Canada Growth Fund (up to US$65M); Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BMW i Ventures
notes: 'Up to' US$85M structured financing; equity/debt split not stated. A separate tax-credit-backed loan from National Bank of Canada is not included.

name: Cyclic Materials
activity: Recovers rare-earth oxides from end-of-life magnets and electronic waste through a hub-and-spoke recycling network.
lead_investors: Accounts advised by T. Rowe Price; existing investors
notes: Second US$75M in the window: a US$75M Series C was announced 2026-01-23 (Canada Growth Fund US$25M). Total equity raised reported as US$237M after August.

name: Solcoa Industries
activity: Makes rare-earth metals (NdPr, samarium) with a new metal-making process; building a 500 t/yr plant (Solcoa One).
lead_investors: Bain Capital Ventures
notes: Headline US$75M = US$45M equity plus US$30M debt and equipment financing from JPMorgan (split per Axios Pro).

name: pH7 Technologies
activity: Closed-loop electrochemical process extracting metals from low-grade ore, tailings and waste (Vancouver).
lead_investors: Fine Structure Ventures; Asahi Kasei, Circular Innovation Fund, BHP Ventures, Pangaea Ventures
notes: Final close of nearly US$32M equity (initial close US$25.6M on 2025-12-04); plus venture debt from RBCx (reported US$7.5M) not included.

name: Phoenix Tailings
activity: Refines rare-earth oxides into rare-earth metals with a low-emission process (plants in Massachusetts and New Hampshire).
lead_investors: Traxys (strategic), Eni Next, Geodesic Alliance Fund
notes: Release frames US$40.2M: US$30.2M equity plus US$10M venture debt. Series B total US$116.6M. Valuation US$360M per Bloomberg citing the CEO.

name: Atana Elements
activity: AI-led exploration company using oil-and-gas fluid-systems know-how to find brine-hosted lithium and other flowing mineral systems.
lead_investors: Lowercarbon Capital
notes: Syndicated company press release. Also targets hydrogen and helium.

name: LOHUM Cleantech
activity: Recycles lithium-ion batteries and recovers battery materials (Delhi area).
lead_investors: Poonawalla Vision Fund I (Ambit Global Private Client) and family offices
notes: Investor's release: INR 230 crore; USD about 26M at about 88-89 INR/USD (approximate). Equity structure not stated. Earlier INR 131.4 crore pre-Series C reported Nov 2025.

name: Lithosquare
activity: Geology-AI platform that speeds up discovery of critical-metal deposits for mining companies (Paris).
lead_investors: World Fund and Kindred Capital
notes: Investor press release; some outlets quote about EUR 21-22M for the same round.

name: Magrathea
activity: Produces magnesium metal by electrolysis from seawater-derived brines (California).
notes: Axios Pro report (paywalled; amount from snippets quoting it); another outlet dates the round March 2026. Lead investors not confirmed from a primary source.

name: Terra AI
activity: Generative-AI platform building probabilistic 3D subsurface models from geophysics, geochemistry and drilling data (Palo Alto).
lead_investors: Khosla Ventures; BHP Ventures (strategic)

name: Allonnia
activity: Biotechnology (D-Solve) that dissolves gangue minerals to upgrade concentrates in existing mineral processing.
lead_investors: Viking Global, Bison Ventures, General Atlantic, BHP Ventures, Pivotal Capital Partners (no single lead named)
notes: 'More than US$20M' - the amount is a floor.

name: Cuprum Metals
activity: Patented chemical leaching that recovers copper from sulphide (including chalcopyrite) and oxide ores and tailings.
lead_investors: Lundin Family Office; Woodline Partners, BHP Ventures

name: Hades Mining
activity: Developing laser drilling to reach deep critical-raw-material and geothermal targets at lower cost (Munich).
lead_investors: HV Capital and Headline
notes: Announced as EUR 15M.

name: Solar Materials
activity: Recycles end-of-life solar modules, recovering glass, silver, silicon, copper and other materials (Magdeburg).
lead_investors: EIC Fund and NOVA by Saint-Gobain (new); bmp Ventures, IBG Funds, First Imagine! (existing)
notes: Amount unresolved: 'up to EUR 20M' (Startbase) vs EUR 15M (Nordic 9); may include conditional tranches. Announced about 17-22 Apr 2026.

name: R3 Lithium
activity: Commercial-scale plant recovering lithium carbonate from recycled battery black mass (Covington, Georgia).
lead_investors: TDK Ventures; Integral GlobalTech Partners, Axial Partners
notes: Law-firm release; company release not read.

name: Advanced Electric Machines
activity: Makes electric motors without permanent magnets or rare earths, using aluminium instead of copper windings (North East England).
lead_investors: Barclays Climate Ventures, PXN Ventures, Northstar Ventures, Low Carbon Innovation Fund (existing) plus new investors
notes: GBP 16M combines equity and an Innovate UK loan; the split is not published. Rare earths listed because the motors avoid them (substitution).

name: Princeton Critical Minerals
activity: Brine lithium production technology (evaporation enhancement, AI pond monitoring, selective crystallisation); Princeton University spin-out, formerly PureLi.
lead_investors: SOSV; Grantham Foundation, Prospect Innovation, ASTOR Management, Black Forest Ventures, NJEDA
notes: US$16M package = US$11M Series A plus over US$5M non-dilutive grants (NSF, ARPA-E, NJEDA).

name: BatX Energies
activity: Lithium-ion battery recycling and critical-mineral recovery by shredding and hydrometallurgy (Gurugram).
lead_investors: IvyCap Ventures
notes: INR 105 crore, reported as about US$11M.

name: alqem
activity: AI-driven materials discovery, starting with rare-earth-free magnets (Munich; also Coimbra).
lead_investors: UVC Partners and Union Square Ventures
notes: Announced as EUR 8M (lead investor's post). Rare earths listed because the magnets avoid them (substitution).

name: Riven Systems
activity: AI and autonomous-lab development of extractants and separation chemistry for critical-mineral processing (New York).
lead_investors: Cerberus Ventures (reported)
notes: Axios Pro (paywalled); amount and lead from summaries citing it.

name: Renewable Metals
activity: Recovers battery metals from end-of-life lithium-ion batteries with an alkali-based hydrometallurgical process (Perth).
lead_investors: Clean Energy Finance Corporation (via Virescent Ventures)
notes: Announced as AUD 12M (oversubscribed, upsized from AUD 8M).

name: NEU Battery Materials
activity: Recycles LFP battery scrap and black mass into battery-grade lithium with an electrochemical process.
lead_investors: Shift4Good and SGInnovate

name: Giraffe Bio
activity: Cell-free biochemical flotation reagents, made by engineered microbes, to raise copper recovery (South America).
lead_investors: Orion Industrial Ventures; BHP Ventures, Twynam, Air Capital, Baruch Future Ventures
notes: HQ country not confirmed (company says South America; Argentina and Chile operations mentioned).

name: Transition Metal Solutions
activity: Low-cost additives for heap leach piles that boost native microbes to raise copper recovery (formerly Transition Biomining).
lead_investors: Transition Ventures; SOSV and others
notes: Not the Canadian explorer Transition Metals Corp.

name: Karo Sambhav
activity: Recovers critical and precious materials from e-waste and runs producer-responsibility recycling programmes (Gurugram).
lead_investors: Rainmatter
notes: INR 56 crore, reported as about US$5.9M.

name: Entellus Industries
activity: Makes rare-earth metals and alloys (NdPr metal, strip-cast alloys, bonded powders) for permanent magnets (Chennai).
lead_investors: ZeroW (Mekapati Family Office)
notes: INR 50 crore, reported as about US$5.5M.

name: Altillion
activity: Extracts minerals (iodine, lithium, bromine and others) from oilfield produced water, geothermal brines and salars.
lead_investors: EIC Rose Rock and Flathead Forge
notes: Reproduces the company release. HQ city conflicts (Tulsa vs Houston). Not the same company as Altilium (UK).

name: Vimag Labs
activity: Electric motors that replace rare-earth permanent magnets with a 'virtual magnet' design (Bengaluru).
lead_investors: Accel; Chakra Growth Fund, Thinkuvate
notes: Series A label from secondary headlines. Rare earths listed because the motors avoid them (substitution).

name: FAST Metals
activity: Recovers aluminium, scandium, titanium and rare earths from red mud (alumina refinery waste) after first removing iron.
lead_investors: New Climate Ventures; Azolla Ventures, Astor Swiss, Founders Factory (Rio Tinto accelerator)

name: Radify Metals
activity: Hydrogen-plasma reactors that reduce rare-earth oxides to metals (Campbell, California).
lead_investors: Overture, Founders Inc., Mana Ventures, Acequia Capital (no lead named)
notes: 'Just under US$3M' (TechCrunch); one report says US$2.9M closed Dec 2025. Date is the first public report.

name: Alkemio
activity: Bio-based chemistry to separate rare-earth elements at the mine site, starting with dysprosium (Buenos Aires).
lead_investors: Dalus Capital, VU Venture Partners, Amplifica Capital, VX Ventures, Epic Angels (no lead named)

name: HIT Mag
activity: Rare-earth-free iron nitride permanent magnets made with a proprietary magnetic powder process (Plouzané, Brittany).
lead_investors: LITA, Bpifrance, SATT Ouest Valorisation, Breizh Up and business angel networks (no lead named)
notes: EUR 1.6M; round reportedly closed end 2025; may include public funding (Bpifrance). Rare earths listed because the magnets avoid them (substitution).

name: Quminex
activity: Machine-learning platform generating explainable mineral exploration targets from geological data (Quebec).
lead_investors: Quantacet; QAI Ventures and angels
notes: CAD 1.5M, reported as about US$1.06M.

name: Altilium
activity: Recycles end-of-life EV batteries into battery-grade materials; building a commercial refinery in Plymouth.
lead_investors: SQM and Marubeni Corporation (follow-on)
notes: Amount undisclosed. A separate GBP 18.5M DRIVE35 grant is not included.
